name: Financial Services & Asset Management
shortDescription: Navigating banking, private equity, hedge funds, sovereign wealth managers, and DIFC/ADGM regulated capital market vehicles.
description: Financial institutions face intricate tax interactions under UAE Corporate Tax and VAT. From qualifying investment fund exemptions under Article 10 to financial services input tax recovery apportionment methods, Taxmetryx designs resilient fiscal structures for banks, private equity managers, and credit funds.
challenges: Securing Qualifying Investment Fund (QIF) corporate tax exemption
Partial input tax apportionment for exempt vs taxable financial supplies
OECD Chapter X transfer pricing for intercompany lending and credit guarantees
advisoryFocus: Article 10 Qualifying Investment Fund Application
Special Method Input Tax Recovery Approval with the FTA
Private Equity Carried Interest & Management Fee Structuring

name: Technology & Digital Assets
shortDescription: Cross-border intellectual property routing, SaaS taxation, digital platforms, and VARA/ADGM regulated virtual asset entities.
description: Technology platforms operate borderless businesses with centralized software development, global cloud infrastructure, and distributed remote teams. We structure DEMPE-compliant IP ownership models, navigate SaaS withholding tax leakage, and guide crypto funds through CARF and UAE Corporate Tax rules.
challenges: Establishing tangible economic substance for IP holding companies
Withholding taxes on cross-border software licenses and cloud APIs
Virtual asset token classification for corporate tax and VAT
advisoryFocus: OECD Transfer Pricing Profit Split & Royalty Benchmarking
Free Zone Qualifying Intellectual Property Structuring

name: Real Estate & Construction
shortDescription: Structuring commercial and residential property developments, joint ventures, Capital Assets Scheme VAT, and Free Zone property rules.
description: The UAE real estate boom demands precise fiscal navigation. Under UAE Corporate Tax, immovable property held in Free Zones is subject to standard 9% tax unless specific conditions are met. Under VAT, developers must navigate the Capital Assets Scheme, retention payments, and mixed commercial-residential classifications.
challenges: Free Zone exclusion for income derived from mainland immovable property
Capital Assets Scheme 10-year VAT adjustment compliance
Contractor retention payments and reverse charge mechanics
advisoryFocus: Property Joint Venture Tax Optimization
Capital Asset VAT Health Checks & Apportionment
Article 27 Restructuring Relief for Property Transfers

description: From luxury global retail houses to fast-scaling e-commerce marketplaces, consumer brands require frictionless supply chains. Taxmetryx advises on Designated Zone bonded warehousing, customs duty tariff optimization, promotional discounts under VAT, and distributor pricing policies.

Transfer pricing margins for exclusive regional distributors
Customs valuation interaction with intercompany TP year-end adjustments
advisoryFocus: Designated Zone Warehousing & Logistics Tax Structuring

name: Manufacturing & Industrials
shortDescription: Qualifying Free Zone manufacturing incentives, supply chain transfer pricing, R&D tax optimization, and capital asset depreciation.
description: Industrial production is a prioritized pillar under Operation 300bn. Free Zone manufacturing operations enjoy explicit Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP) 0% corporate tax status, provided strict raw material sourcing and substantive local processing criteria are substantiated.
challenges: Demonstrating genuine value-add manufacturing within Free Zone boundaries
Cost-plus transfer pricing models for toll vs contract manufacturers
Import duty exemptions under industrial licensing frameworks
advisoryFocus: QFZP Manufacturing Eligibility & De Minimis Safeguards
Cost Sharing & Contract Manufacturing TP Agreements
Tax Depreciation & Opening Balance Valuation Optimization
